general_info.college: Savitribai Phule Shikshan Prasark Mandal’s, ‘SKN Sinhgad college of Engineering’
general_info.approval: Approved by AICTE and affiliated to Solapur University, Solapur.
general_info.rule_followed: Follows rules and regulations laid down by ‘Director of Technical Education’ Maharashtra State.
general_info.programs_offered: 6 Undergraduate programs and 4 post graduate programs.

maharashtra_state: Passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subject/Computer Science/IT/Informatics Practices/Agriculture/Engineering Graphics/Business Studies/Electronics/Entrepreneurship.
Obtained at least 45% marks (40% for Reserved categories, EWS, PwD belonging to Maharashtra State) in the above subjects taken together.
Appeared in all subjects in PCM MHT-CET 2025 and obtained non-zero score in PCM MHT-CET 2025.
all_india_and_maharashtra: Passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subject/Computer Science/IT/Informatics Practices/Agriculture/Engineering Graphics/Business Studies/Electronics/Entrepreneurship.
Obtained at least 45% marks (40% for Reserved categories, EWS, PwD belonging to Maharashtra State).
Obtained non-zero positive score in JEE (Main) OR appeared in all subjects in PCM MHT-CET 2025 and obtained non-zero score. Preference given to JEE candidates.
OR Passed minimum three years Diploma in Engineering and Technology with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories).
OR Passed three years D.Voc. stream in the same or allied sector.

maharashtra_and_all_india: Passed minimum three years or two years (Lateral Entry) Diploma Course in Engineering and Technology with at least 45% marks (40% for Reserved categories, EWS, PwD belonging to Maharashtra State) from an AICTE or Govt. approved institution.
OR Passed B.Sc. Degree from a UGC recognized University with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories) and passed HSC with Mathematics.
OR Passed three years D.Voc. Stream in the same or allied sector.

Passed Bachelor Degree in the relevant field of Engineering and Technology or Pharmacy from AICTE or Govt. approved institutions, with at least 50% marks (45% for Reserved categories, EWS, PwD belonging to Maharashtra State).
Obtained Qualified score in GATE/GPAT OR non-Qualified marks in GATE/GPAT for the current academic year.
OR For sponsored candidates, minimum of two years of full time work experience in the relevant field.
OR Minimum of two years of full time work experience in the relevant field (eligible for institute level only).
